Review complete (`verdict: "approved"`, 0 findings):

- **Correctness**: `invertDarkModeFilter` in `packages/common/src/colors.ts` and `getCurrentColor` in `packages/excalidraw/components/EyeDropper.tsx` implement the change plan specification accurately.
- **Type safety**: Strict TypeScript typing preserved (`GlobalPoint` parameter on `pointFrom`, narrowed palette and element types, no `any`).
- **Error handling & edge cases**: Transparent colors, alpha channels, deleted/image elements, view background fallback, and general inverse fallback are all handled cleanly.
- **DRY & caching**: Browser-only cache (`DARK_MODE_INVERSE_COLORS_CACHE`) and lazy palette inverse map (`getDarkModePaletteInverseMap`) match `applyDarkModeFilter` conventions.
- **Test coverage**: Unit and component tests in `colors.test.ts` and `eyeDropper.test.tsx` cover palette round-trips, unclamped/clamped custom colors, alpha preservation, cursor z-order tie-breaking, stroke/background disambiguation, and fallback behavior.
